episodes.title: The Cyclone
episodes.summary: Awaiting a make-or-break visit from a food critic, restaurateur Jake Friedken is thrown off-center by the return of his troublesome brother, Vince.

episodes.title: The Black Rabbits
episodes.summary: Riding high, Jake begins to dream of a second restaurant — until a financial curveball puts both him and Vince in jeopardy with their creditors.

episodes.title: Skin Contact
episodes.summary: When Jake and Vince throw a lavish last-minute fundraiser, Roxie suspects an ulterior motive. A disgruntled former employee rears his head.

episodes.title: No More F**k-Ups
episodes.summary: Jake scrambles to conceal the truth after a reporter starts snooping around the Rabbit. A moment of overconfidence puts Vince in even deeper danger.

episodes.title: Trailblazer
episodes.summary: When Junior and Babbit turn up the heat, the brothers respond in kind. Roxie appeals to Wes to make changes at the restaurant.

episodes.title: Attaf**kinboy
episodes.summary: As deals, debts and double-crosses intensify, all roads lead to one fateful night at the Rabbit.

episodes.title: These Kids Nearly Got Munsoned
episodes.summary: A furious Mancuso vows to settle the score with Vince. Jake faces tough questions from every direction. Estelle wrestles with guilt.

episodes.title: Isle of Joy
episodes.summary: With threats closing in on all sides, the brothers make a final bid for survival that brings them face-to-face with their complicated past.
